intent: A drowned moon-priestess glade: dark blue-black woods round a barrow field of pale green-grey stone, still black pools and one cold silver-teal well-light, whose ring of standing stones and glowing pool is the landmark that pulls the eye across the map from the high camera.
requests: A `well` sculpt kind (a round stone kerb round a black shaft) to stand inside the sacred ring; the `wayside` well form is a roofed road well and cannot read as a moonwell from above.
A way to make a `waystones` ring solid so bodies stop at the stones without blocking the walk into the ring; props are all walk-through except boulders.
A water-sheet sculpt that can carry a light, so the ring's pool reads as still water rather than a Neon dome.
A cold preset of its own (colder moon, blue-black haze); the job could only name `mood`.
